name: Cannot Look Away
desc: They notice every wound, every act of violence, whether they wish to or not. It costs them.

name: Marked by the Conductor
desc: A punch-shaped scar on the palm. Sealed doors recognize it. So, always, does the Conductor.

name: Borrowed Memory
desc: They can reach into the recollections of dead passengers. Sometimes they speak in those voices.

name: Bloodless
desc: Their wounds barely bleed and poison finds nothing to grip. Medicine finds little more.

name: Out of Time
desc: Once per carriage, a failed moment folds back and lets them try again. Each fold ages them visibly.

name: The Passenger's Smile
desc: The train's inhabitants find them charming, familiar, one of their own. The party has begun to notice too.

name: Hollow Bones
desc: They move soundlessly and slip through gaps no adult should manage. They break like china.

name: Two Shadows
desc: They cast a second shadow that sees disguised and invisible things. It does not always point where they do.
